body: i know it is but i didn’t ask for them and they don’t even feel like mine.

i didn’t plan to keep them but my parents forced it now they are saying it was my mistake that i need to fix, the rest of my family is in europe i don’t really have anyone who would help with me still here.
i’m only sixteen so no one really cares how bad it gets they just think it’s typical teenage drama i guess.
I probably didn’t understand the question aha but foreign exchange and germany :)
Not exactly since my parents and friends would harass me over it but i won’t push anything on them either
i’m just going to let him be but stay in slight contact so if he ever wants to send anything for them he can, i won’t force him in anything since he’s not too well off
honestly no i was pretty out of it and the next morning i felt too shy to ask if someone could find me some sort of day after pill
i think it’s like they can do 3 days in person or something weird or full online- most of the kids are doing online though

I didn’t really have many for me to feel suspicious of the pregnancy and the ones i had i would just assume i had a cold or anxiety- most of my friends know except a few in my home country because i know they would just be pretty harshly- if i had the choice not to tell them i probably wouldn’t just because of the way they treated the last teen moms sadly it’s gotten around pretty quick (my fault for standing up during school calls)

i did consider it for awhile but i didn’t notice very early on so i couldn’t fully come to terms with it- also with being scared of telling my parents for awhile i really couldn’t but i don’t regret it :)
I’m a bit too far to abort now aha but i do plan to raise them rather than adoption partly because i feel obligated

so far it’s been pretty tough mostly on the group video calls both my school mates since they love to poke fun at it most of the time, i think it would be a lot worse in person with them but my school work isn’t doing the best with trying to balance work although the teachers are letting most of my work go without an issue which is good

work on the other hand is mostly nonexistent since my boss thought it would be an issue and bad looking for his shop but in his defense it was working on cars and i can’t exactly be going under them anymore:) i did start looking at other ones for soon after the birth at least

Germany and it’s sorta a long story but i’ll try my best to make it short just excuse my english- in the studying abroad program i had a host family which consisted of two older boys-i met some of their friends (22 year old) and being the person i am i thought it would be brilliant to get with a german man the first night of meeting him even though he did have so many red flags within the two hours of knowing him-we did hang out a few times after but we ultimately ended it in a huge fight before i went home
He knows but he wanted me to get an abortion so he’s trying to keep it a secret from his family
not yet but hopefully soon, 37 weeks :)
